description: Citation ledger: which real file/line-range backs every token, section, and template decision in this design-repo. Every measuredFrom string embedded across tokens/, primitives/, components/, sections/, templates/, compatibility/ is validated by extraction/verify_all.py's citation-range-validity check, which resolves the path against the sibling source tree used to BUILD this repo. That sibling tree (relative paths: spec/, src/, CLONE_SPEC.md, tailwind.config.cjs, all under the original cloned project's own root) is NOT part of this design-repo package — it is the original cloned project this design-repo was extracted FROM. When this design-repo is copied/zipped standalone without that sibling tree present, the citation check degrades gracefully: it WARNS that it cannot verify citations rather than failing the run.
sourceProjectNote: This design-repo was built from a sibling project directory containing spec/, src/, public/assets/, CLONE_SPEC.md and tailwind.config.cjs. Those paths are cited by RELATIVE name only inside measuredFrom strings (e.g. 'CLONE_SPEC.md:177', 'spec/GRID.md:45') — never as an absolute machine path — so the citation check can attempt path resolution relative to a configurable sibling root without ever embedding a literal absolute filesystem path anywhere in this repo.

realCompany.fact: Valley (joinvalley.co) is a real, live company. Case studies name 21 real third-party companies (Gallea AI, Smallest.ai, Klaar, etc.) and real named people.
realCompany.implication: Every assetRole touching a customer/competitor logo or a real person's photo carries must-reuse-exact or must-not-fabricate generationPolicy — never may-generate-new. See tokens/llm/asset-role-registry.json.

placeholderBodyContent.fact: Blog post bodies (492 posts), case study bodies (21 cases), and legal page bodies (terms/privacy) are deliberately generated placeholder text, not scraped real content.
placeholderBodyContent.implication: sections/content.article-body.json and sections/content.legal-prose.json both declare an explicit contentPolicy block distinguishing measured-real metadata fields from generated-placeholder body fields.

realThirdPartyEndpoints.fact: 18 files (25 occurrences) reference two real live third-party endpoints: the Surface booking form and the beta signup/HubSpot booking URLs.
realThirdPartyEndpoints.implication: Every content field carrying one of these values is PINNED via JSON Schema `const` in the owning section contract (not just closed-enum membership), independently re-verified by schema/semantic_validate.py's dedicated pinned-value check — see compatibility/graph.json rule PINNED_LIVE_ENDPOINT_VALUES.

deadRouteShim.fact: /blog_featured/* is a deliberate React Router redirect shim to /blog, reproducing a real 308 the live site performs. Not a missing template.

blogArchiveOutsideLayout.fact: /blog/archive is a bare top-level route rendered OUTSIDE the shared <Layout> (no nav/footer chrome), unlike every other route.

routeCountMath.fact: 530 total real routes map to 16 template shapes: 6 main pages + 3 landing-template routes (1 shape) + 3 other unique landing pages (3 shapes) + blog-index (1) + blog-archive (1) + 492 blog-post routes (1 shape) + casestudies-index (1) + 21 casestudy routes (1 shape) + 2 legal routes (1 shape) = 6+3+3+1+1+492+1+21+2 = 530.

casestudyCountVerified21NotN22.fact: There are 21 case studies, not 22. Confirmed against sitemap.xml and Framer's search index; other /casestudies/<slug> links found inside blog posts 308-redirect to /blog/...

jobsPinningQuirk.fact: At viewport 810-816 the jobs (.vstack) section is stacked and NOT pinned (height 1803.5); at 801-809 it has 4 columns and IS pinned (height 2846) — a real quirk of gutter math crossing the tablet/phone boundary, reproduced deliberately.

landingTemplateStickyBarPrecedesNav.fact: The 3 SEO landing-template routes render a fixed bottom sticky-bar whose DOM position precedes <nav> in source order, even though it renders visually at the bottom of the viewport.

phoneOverflowClipQuirk.fact: At phone width the landing-template hero's eyebrow tag and video caption are wider than the viewport and get clipped by horizontal overflow — a defect in the ORIGINAL live site, reproduced deliberately, not fixed.

agencyPathsPhoneCollapseQuirk.fact: On phone, the /linkedin-outreach-for-agencies path cards collapse to 56px tall and clip their content to only the label — a real, deliberate quirk of the original.

automationBentoHrefQuirk.fact: The linkedin-automation case-study bento cards use href='./' verbatim (linking to the home page), not their own case study URL — a real quirk of the original, not a broken link to silently fix.

tokenProvenanceSummary.motion: src/index.css:52; spec/components.css (multiple @keyframes, line-cited per entry in tokens/00-foundation/motion.json)

gracefulDegradationNote: extraction/verify_all.py's citation-range-validity check looks for a sibling source tree at a configurable --source-root (default: the design-repo's own parent directory). If that tree is absent (e.g. this design-repo was copied/unzipped standalone with no sibling project), the check prints a WARNING per unresolved citation and continues, rather than failing the run — this is the deliberate degrade-gracefully behavior BUILD-GUIDE.md section 2.7 requires, and it is proven by the self-containment test (see extraction/verify_all.py's own docstring and the build session's self-containment run).
